title: Bands he played with: Lewisty Man, Dusen, Carey, Humphrey
summary: He considers himself a member only of Lewisty Man's band but played with Dusen, Carey, Percy, and Earl Foster.

blocks.x: Can you tell us some more about Frankie Dewson's band, or, or, who you played with then?

Well, Frankie Dewson, uh, uh, I never did play with his, his band, but I played, he played on, on Lewisty Man's band, see? Well, he was with Lewisty Man. Yeah, he was with Lewisty Man. Me and Lewisty Man and, uh, and Wilkin LaBeth. You remember Wilkin LaBeth? Yes.
I don't know. I heard of him.
And, uh, and L. Gabriel, Manny Gabriel, Clarence Gabriel at least, was playing the band.
That would be after you left Jack Carey's band, would it?

Well I've never called myself on the band as a member, you know, but I've played with him. I've never called myself a member of, uh, no band but Lewisty Man. Mm-hmm. See, I only, yeah, that's the only band that I consider myself playing in a band, you know?
But you probably have played with a lot of other bands.

Oh yeah, like, uh, played with, uh, Jack Carey and, uh, Frankie Dewson, and played with, uh, Willie Alpey, not Willie, Earl. Earl, the job one way. No, no, the trumpet player was, Percy. Percy. Percy, yeah, yeah, Percy.
Well I played with his band, and I played with, uh, the other band I played with, what should I, uh, with, uh, Earl, uh, Foster. You know Earl Foster?
I don't know him, but I don't know him.
